name: PhotoPrism
description: Browse, search and organize your photos with AI tagging.
notes: Log in as admin; the password is in /opt/photoprism/.nova-secrets (SECRET1).
compose:
services:
  photoprism:
    image: photoprism/photoprism:latest
    container_name: photoprism
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:2342"
    environment:
      PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_USER: "admin"
      PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD: "{SECRET1}"
      PHOTOPRISM_DATABASE_DRIVER: "sqlite"
      PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL: "http://localhost:2342/"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/storage:/photoprism/storage
      - /srv/photos:/photoprism/originals
